value.rationale: Cycle is the canonical nontrivial bounded-degree topology explicitly used in the motivating 2023 literature. An exact all-parameter finite equilibrium-count spectrum provides concrete equilibrium multiplicity information beyond general existence/feasibility. The parity PoS theorem is a sharp, intrinsically motivated obstruction to social-optimum implementation that appears only in \(2<t<3\) for odd cycles; it has exact witnesses and loss size.
